title: The JRE Analytical Paragraph
summary: إزاي تكتب فقرة تحليلية (150-180 كلمة) بطريقة JRE: رأي واضح، سبب، دليل من النص، شرح، وخاتمة.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: An **analytical paragraph** answers a question with a clear **claim**, a **reason**, **evidence** from the text, an **explanation** and a **concluding sentence**. In this book we build it with **JRE: Justify – Reasoning – Evidence**.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن أهم نوع كتابة في كتاب تانية بكالوريا كله: **الـ Analytical Paragraph** (فقرة تحليلية). يعني إيه؟ يعني حد يسألك سؤال زي «To what extent…?» وإنت ترد بـ **رأي واضح**، و**سبب**، و**دليل من النص**، وتشرح الدليل ده بيثبت كلامك إزاي.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 1 : Living Well in a Complex World**، صفحة **Writing: How to Structure an Analytical Paragraph** (صفحة 26-27)، وبعدها Writing Task صفحة 32 و**Summative Assessment** صفحة 36. والكتاب بيطلب الفقرة **(150-180) words**.
خلي بالك: الطريقة دي (JRE) مش بس للكتابة. الكتاب بيستخدمها في القراءة والـ speaking وأسئلة الجنب في كل الوحدات. يعني لو فهمتها كويس هنا هتنفعك السنة كلها.
يعني إيه JRE؟

text: **J = Justify**: take a clear position (your claim). **R = Reasoning**: explain why. **E = Evidence**: support it with facts or examples from the text. The book adds **+ Reflect and Act**: think about what this means in real life.

blocks.text: الكتاب بيسمي الطريقة دي **JRE+ Inquiry Model**. بص عليها كأنك محامي في المحكمة:

rows: Justify (claim / position)
قول رأيك أو موقفك بوضوح
أنا شايف إيه؟ موافق ولا لأ؟ وبأي درجة؟
Reason
السبب: ليه شايف كده؟
ليه؟ إيه المنطق؟
Evidence
الدليل: معلومة، رقم، دراسة، مثال من النص
إيه اللي يثبت كلامي من النص؟
Reflect and Act
إيه معنى ده في الحياة؟ نعمل إيه؟
الكلام ده يفرق معايا ومع المجتمع إزاي؟

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ: المحامي
items: **J** = المحامي بيقول: «موكلي بريء» (ده الـ claim).
**R** = «لأنه كان مسافر يوم الحادثة» (ده السبب).
**E** = «ودي تذكرة الطيارة» (ده الدليل).
من غير دليل القاضي مش هيصدق. ونفس الكلام مع المصحح: **رأي من غير دليل = كلام ضعيف**.

blocks.text: هيكل الفقرة زي ما الكتاب بيشرحه (5 أجزاء)

text: The book gives five parts: **1. Topic Sentence (Claim) – 2. Reason – 3. Evidence – 4. Explanation – 5. Concluding Sentence.** In a 150-180-word paragraph, you can repeat Evidence + Explanation two or three times.

blocks.text: الكتاب بيقسم الفقرة لخمس جمل أساسية. بس علشان توصل لـ 150-180 كلمة، إنت بتكرر **الدليل + الشرح** مرتين أو تلاتة، وممكن تضيف **رأي معارض (However…)** وترد عليه.

rows: 1. **Topic Sentence (Claim)**
a clear opinion that answers the question
جملة أولى فيها رأيك وبترد على السؤال مباشرة
Sleep is the most important habit for teenagers' well-being.
2. **Reason**
explain WHY your claim is right
السبب، وغالبًا بيبدأ بـ This is because
This is because sleep supports both the body and the mind.
3. **Evidence**
information from the text, examples or facts
دليل من النص: رقم، دراسة، مثال
According to the text, teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep.
4. **Explanation**
explain how the evidence supports the claim
تشرح الدليل ده بيثبت كلامك إزاي
This shows that missing sleep can harm concentration and mood.
(اختياري) **Counter-point**
show the other side, then answer it
رأي تاني ورد عليه
However, exercise also matters, since it helps people sleep deeply.
5. **Concluding Sentence**
restate and strengthen your idea
تأكيد الرأي بكلام مختلف
Therefore, sleep is the foundation of a healthy lifestyle.

blocks.title: خلي بالك
blocks.text: الـ Explanation هو أكتر جزء الطلبة بتنساه. ماتحطش الدليل وتمشي! لازم جملة بعده تقول **This shows that… / This suggests that… / This indicates that…** وتربط الدليل بالرأي بتاعك.
عبارات مفيدة (من الكتاب + زيادة)
العبارات دي الكتاب حطها في Writing Task صفحة 32 وفي الـ Writing Frame صفحة 36. احفظ من كل مجموعة 2-3 بس واستخدمهم كل مرة:

groups.title: Opening the topic (البداية)
items: The issue of … is widely discussed today.
This paragraph examines … using evidence from the text.
I believe that … because …
It can be argued that …

groups.title: Giving the reason (السبب)
items: This is because …
The main reason is that …
One reason for this is that …

groups.title: Giving evidence (الدليل)
items: The text shows that …
According to the text, …
It's suggested that …
Research indicates that …
For example, … / For instance, …

groups.title: Explaining (الشرح)
items: This suggests that …
This indicates that …
This shows that …
In other words, …

groups.title: Adding & contrasting (إضافة ورأي تاني)
items: Furthermore, … / Moreover, …
However, …
In contrast, the text highlights that …
It's argued that …; however, …

groups.title: Concluding (الختام)
items: Therefore, …
Overall, it can be argued that … because …
If …, then …
To conclude, …

blocks.text: لغة محايدة وحذرة (Neutral and Hedging Language)

text: Unit 1 asks you to use **neutral** and **hedging** language in evidence-based writing. **Hedging** words (may, might, could, suggest, tend to, likely) show caution. **Absolute** words (always, never, all, everyone) make a claim sound biased.

blocks.text: الكتاب في Unit 1 بيقول إن الكتابة الأكاديمية لازم تكون **دقيقة وحذرة**. يعني ماتقولش «كل المراهقين» أو «دايمًا» إلا لو عندك دليل 100%. بدل كده استخدم كلمات الـ **hedging** (كلمات بتخفف الحكم وبتبين إنك حذر).

rows: All teenagers are addicted to their phones.
**Many** teenagers **seem to** spend too much time on their phones.
All ← Many، وزودنا seem to
Junk food destroys your health.
Junk food **may** have a negative effect on health.
destroys ← may have a negative effect
Exercise always makes people happy.
Research **suggests that** exercise **can** improve mood.
always شلناها، وزودنا suggests that + can
Social media is the worst thing for teenagers.
Excessive social media use **could** affect **some** teenagers' self-esteem.
worst ← could affect some

items.en: Teenagers who sleep less **tend to** feel more anxious.
items.ar: tend to = «غالبًا بيميلوا لـ». أهدى من «are always anxious».

items.en: This habit **is likely to** improve concentration.
items.ar: is likely to = «غالبًا هيـ». احتمال قوي مش أكيد 100%.

items.en: **If** schools offer counselling, stress levels **may** fall.
items.ar: الكتاب بيستخدم الـ conditionals للـ hedging: «لو… ممكن…».

items.en: **It could be argued that** diet is as important as exercise.
items.ar: طريقة مهذبة تقول بيها رأي أو رأي تاني.

blocks.text: القواعد اللي بتخدم الفقرة

text: Unit 1 grammar helps you write JRE: **relative clauses** and **participial phrases** introduce evidence and define key terms, and **conditionals** add caution.

blocks.text: الكتاب بيربط قواعد الوحدة بالكتابة. حاول تحط في فقرتك واحدة على الأقل من كل نوع:

items.en: Teenagers **who exercise regularly** tend to sleep more deeply.
items.ar: **Relative clause**: بتحدد مين بالظبط وبتقدّم الدليل بدقة.

items.en: Mindfulness, **which involves paying attention to the present moment**, can reduce stress.
items.ar: **Relative clause** بتعرّف مصطلح (define a key term).

items.en: Teenagers **sleeping fewer than seven hours** are more likely to report anxiety.
items.ar: **Participial phrase**: نسخة أقصر من who sleep.

items.en: **If** teenagers had a regular bedtime routine, they **would** probably sleep better.

blocks.text: إزاي تكتب الفقرة خطوة بخطوة

items: **اقرا السؤال كويس** وحط خط تحت الكلمة المهمة: To what extent؟ (بأي درجة) / Why؟ / How؟ / Should؟ ده بيحدد شكل الـ claim.
**قرر موقفك في ثانية**: موافق جدًا؟ موافق لحد ما؟ مش موافق؟ اختار الأسهل في الدليل، مش الأحلى في الكلام.
**دوّر في النص على دليلين** (رقم، دراسة، مثال). علّم عليهم.
**اكتب خطة صغيرة** في الهامش: Claim – Reason – Evidence 1 + Explanation – Evidence 2 + Explanation – However – Conclusion.
**اكتب الـ Topic Sentence**: رأيك + كلمات من السؤال نفسه.
**كمّل بالـ Reason** (This is because…) وبعدين **Evidence** (According to the text…) وبعدين **Explanation** (This suggests that…). كرر مرة كمان بـ Furthermore.
**زوّد رأي تاني بـ However** ورد عليه في جملة. ده بيبين إنك بتفكر بعمق (critical thinking).
**اختم بـ Therefore / Overall** وقول رأيك تاني بكلمات مختلفة.
**راجع**: hedging words؟ relative clause؟ عدد الكلمات بين 150 و180؟ إملاء وعلامات ترقيم؟

blocks.text: موديل كامل
ده موديل على سؤال من Writing Task صفحة 27. اقراه الأول بالإنجليزي، وبعدين بص على الشرح تحته.

blocks.title: Model analytical paragraph (JRE)
blocks.task: To what extent is sleep more important than other lifestyle factors in supporting well-being? Write an analytical paragraph of (150-180) words using evidence from the text.
text: Sleep is arguably the most important lifestyle factor in supporting teenagers' well-being, although exercise, diet and mindfulness also play a significant role. This is because sleep affects the body and the mind at the same time: without enough rest, the benefits of other healthy habits may be reduced. According to the text, teenagers need between eight and ten hours of sleep per night to support brain development, emotional control and physical recovery. Furthermore, research which was published in the journal Sleep Medicine found that teenagers sleeping fewer than seven hours a night were more likely to report anxiety and depression. This suggests that poor sleep could weaken a young person's mental health even if he or she eats well. However, it can be argued that these factors are connected, since the text also shows that teenagers who exercise regularly tend to sleep more deeply. Therefore, sleep may not work alone, but it seems to be the foundation which allows the other habits to succeed. Overall, if teenagers protect their sleep, their whole well-being is likely to improve.
notes: **Topic Sentence (Claim)**: أول جملة بترد على «To what extent» بكلمة **arguably the most important**، وبتعترف إن فيه عوامل تانية (although…). ده رأي واضح ومتوازن.
**Reason**: «This is because sleep affects the body and the mind…». النقطتين (:) هنا للـ **explanation**: بيشرح الجملة اللي قبلها.
**Evidence 1**: «According to the text, teenagers need between eight and ten hours…» = معلومة من النص بكلمات الطالب.
**Evidence 2**: دراسة Sleep Medicine، ومكتوبة بـ **relative clause** (research which was published) و**participial phrase** (teenagers sleeping fewer than…). قواعد الوحدة شغالة جوه الدليل.
**Explanation**: «This suggests that poor sleep could weaken…» بتربط الدليل بالرأي. وفيها hedging (suggests, could).
**Counter-point**: «However, it can be argued that these factors are connected…» رأي تاني مأخوذ من النص برضه، وبعده رد عليه: sleep is the foundation.
**Concluding Sentence**: «Overall, if teenagers protect their sleep…» = تأكيد الرأي بـ **first conditional** + likely.
**Neutral language**: مفيش always ولا all ولا never. فيه arguably, may, could, tend to, seems, likely.

blocks.text: بص إزاي كل جملة في الموديل بتعمل وظيفة:

items.en: Sleep is arguably the most important lifestyle factor…
This is because sleep affects the body and the mind…
According to the text, teenagers need between eight and ten hours…
Furthermore, research which was published… found that…
This suggests that poor sleep could weaken…
However, it can be argued that these factors are connected…
Overall, if teenagers protect their sleep…

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ بتبدأ بقصة طويلة أو تعريف عام (Since the beginning of time…). ✓ ابدأ بالرأي على طول: **Sleep is arguably the most important…**
✗ رأي من غير دليل: I think sleep is important because it is important. ✓ **According to the text, teenagers need eight to ten hours…**
✗ دليل من غير شرح. ✓ بعد كل دليل: **This suggests that…**
✗ كلام مطلق: All teenagers never sleep. ✓ **Many teenagers tend to sleep less than they need.**
✗ تنسخ جملة كاملة من النص. ✓ خد المعلومة واكتبها **بكلماتك** (paraphrase)، وممكن تقتبس كلمتين بس بين علامتي تنصيص.
✗ فقرة 90 كلمة أو 250 كلمة. ✓ الكتاب بيطلب **150-180**. عدّ كلماتك.
✗ تكتب أكتر من فقرة. ✓ المطلوب **paragraph واحدة** متماسكة.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب في الامتحان
items: استخدم **كلمات السؤال** في أول جملة وآخر جملة. ده بيبين إنك فاهم السؤال.
سؤال **To what extent** = لازم درجة: to a great extent / to some extent / arguably the most…
حط **رقمين أو دراستين** من النص لو موجودين. الأرقام أقوى دليل.
جملة **However** واحدة بتفرق جدًا: بتبين إنك شايف الصورة كاملة.
اكتب جمل واضحة ومتوسطة الطول. الجملة الطويلة جدًا بتجيب أخطاء.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي:
**1) سؤال JRE قصير جنب النص** (جملة أو اتنين أو تلاتة): «To what extent is physical activity important for reducing stress? Support your answer with evidence from the text.»

text: **Answer:** Physical activity is very important for reducing stress. This is because, according to the text, exercise causes the release of endorphins, which reduce feelings of stress and anxiety. This suggests that even a brisk walk could help teenagers feel calmer.

blocks.text: الشرح: جملة رأي (J) + سبب ودليل من النص (R + E) + جملة شرح (This suggests that). ده JRE مصغّر.
**2) Writing Task: فقرة تحليلية (150-180) words** بسؤال To what extent / Should / How، زي الموديل اللي فوق.
**3) Summative Assessment**: الكتاب بيديك **Writing Frame** (بدايات جمل) وتكملها. مثال على تكملة البدايات:

items.en: The issue of **social media's influence on lifestyle** is widely discussed today.
This paragraph examines **whether platforms should be held responsible** using evidence from the text.
The text shows that **edited images can create unrealistic expectations**.
This suggests that **platforms share some responsibility**.
However, **users can also choose what they follow**.
Overall, it can be argued that **responsibility is shared** because **both platforms and users make choices**.

blocks.text: تدريب
**A. Which part of the analytical paragraph is each sentence? (Claim / Reason / Evidence / Explanation / Concluding sentence)**

items.q: 1. This shows that mindfulness can have a real effect on the body, not only on the mind.
items.a: **Explanation** — بيبدأ بـ This shows that وبيشرح الدليل.

items.q: 2. Social connection is more important than individual habits for teenagers' well-being.
items.a: **Claim (Topic sentence)** — رأي واضح بيرد على سؤال.

items.q: 3. According to the text, ten minutes of daily mindfulness can reduce stress hormones within a few weeks.
items.a: **Evidence** — According to the text + معلومة.

items.q: 4. Therefore, schools should encourage students to spend more time with friends face to face.
items.a: **Concluding sentence** — Therefore + تأكيد الرأي (وفيها act).

items.q: 5. This is because spending time with others helps us cope with life's pressures.
items.a: **Reason** — This is because.

items.q: 6. However, it could be argued that individual habits such as sleep are just as essential.
items.a: **Counter-point** — However + رأي تاني بلغة حذرة.

blocks.text: **B. Rewrite these biased sentences using neutral and hedging language.**

items.q: 7. Everyone knows that fast food is poison.
items.a: مثال: **Many experts suggest that** eating fast food **regularly may** harm health. — شلنا Everyone و poison.

items.q: 8. Teenagers never exercise these days.
items.a: مثال: **Many** teenagers **do not seem to** exercise enough. — never كلمة مطلقة.

items.q: 9. Social media completely controls young people's minds.
items.a: مثال: Social media **could influence the way some** young people think. — completely ← could influence.

items.q: 10. Mindfulness always cures stress.
items.a: مثال: Research **indicates that** mindfulness **can help reduce** stress. — always و cures أقوى من الدليل.

items.q: 11. All influencers lie about their lifestyle.
items.a: مثال: **Some** influencers **may** present an unrealistic picture of their lifestyle.

blocks.text: **C. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
12. Teenagers need eight to ten hours of sleep. ______, many of them sleep fewer than seven.
a. Therefore  b. However  c. For example  d. Furthermore
items.a: **b. However** — فيه تناقض بين المطلوب والواقع.

items.q:
13. ______ the text, more than 80% of teenagers do not meet the recommended activity levels.
a. Because  b. In contrast  c. According to  d. This shows
items.a: **c. According to** — بنقدّم دليل من النص.

items.q:
14. ______ that physical activity improves both the body and the mind.
a. This suggests  b. However  c. For instance  d. Although
items.a: **a. This suggests** — جملة شرح بعد الدليل.

items.q:
15. Which sentence uses hedging?
a. Exercise always solves stress.  b. Exercise may help reduce stress.  c. Exercise is the only solution.  d. Everybody must exercise.
items.a: **b** — may = حذر. الباقي كلمات مطلقة (always, only, Everybody).

items.q:
16. The best place for 'Therefore, …' is usually:
a. the first sentence  b. the evidence  c. the concluding sentence  d. the reason
items.a: **c** — Therefore بتختم وبتأكد الرأي.

blocks.text: **D. Put the sentences in the correct order to make an analytical paragraph.**

items.q: 17. (a) This indicates that diet affects school performance as well as health. (b) Therefore, a balanced diet should be a priority for every teenager. (c) A balanced diet is essential for teenagers' well-being. (d) According to the text, poor nutrition is linked to fatigue and difficulty concentrating. (e) This is because the food we eat gives us the energy to think and learn.
items.a: **c – e – d – a – b** — Claim ثم Reason ثم Evidence ثم Explanation ثم Conclusion.

blocks.text: **E. JRE questions: answer in 2-3 sentences (claim + reason/evidence + explanation).**

items.q: 18. Is mindful consumption one of the most important life skills for teenagers today? Use ideas from the text.
items.a: مثال: Mindful consumption **can be** a very important skill. **This is because** psychologists advise us to be careful about the media and products we absorb every day, not only food. **This suggests that** teenagers who choose carefully may protect both their health and their self-image.

items.q: 19. To what extent does social connection affect emotional health?
items.a: مثال: Social connection affects emotional health **to a great extent**. **The text shows that** spending time with friends and family face to face can reduce loneliness. **This indicates that** real relationships may build the resilience we need.

items.q: 20. Should schools offer counselling to reduce stress? Justify your answer.
items.a: مثال: **I believe that** schools should offer counselling. **If** students can talk to an expert, their stress levels **may** fall. **This suggests that** counselling could support both their well-being and their studies.

blocks.text: **F. Writing tasks: write an analytical paragraph of (150-180) words.**

items.q: 21. To what extent is personal responsibility important in maintaining a healthy lifestyle?
items.a: خطة مقترحة: **Claim**: important to a great extent, but not the only factor. **Reason**: our daily choices (food, sleep, screens) are in our hands. **Evidence**: the text's advice on bedtime routines / avoiding processed food. **Explanation**: small personal choices can make a measurable difference. **However**: access to resources and education also matters. **Conclusion**: responsibility is mainly personal but society should help.

items.q: 22. Why is social connection more important than individual habits for well-being? Justify your answer.
items.a: خطة مقترحة: **Claim**: social connection may be the most important factor. **Reason**: humans need support to cope with pressure. **Evidence 1**: face-to-face time reduces loneliness. **Evidence 2**: it builds emotional resilience. **Explanation**: habits are easier with friends (exercise together). **However**: sleep and diet are still essential. **Conclusion**: Overall, it can be argued that… because…

blocks.text: Checklist قبل ما تسلّم
دي نفس الـ Analytical Paragraph Rubric بتاعة الكتاب صفحة 27 + شوية حاجات مهمة:

items: جملة 1: **Claim واضح** بيرد على السؤال.
جملة 2: **Reason واضح** (This is because…).
**Evidence من النص** (رقم، دراسة، مثال) مكتوب بكلماتي.
**Explanation** بعد كل دليل (This suggests / shows / indicates that…).
**Concluding sentence** بتأكد الرأي وبتقويه.
استخدمت **hedging** (may, could, tend to, likely) ومفيش كلام مطلق من غير دليل.
استخدمت **relative clause** أو **participial phrase** أو **conditional** واحدة على الأقل.
الفقرة **واحدة** وعدد الكلمات **150-180**.
راجعت الإملاء وعلامات الترقيم.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **JRE** = Justify (رأيك) – Reason (ليه) – Evidence (الدليل من النص)، والكتاب بيزود **Reflect and Act**.
الفقرة 5 أجزاء: **Claim – Reason – Evidence – Explanation – Concluding sentence**، وكرر الدليل والشرح علشان توصل لـ **150-180** كلمة.
بعد كل دليل لازم **شرح**: This suggests that…
اكتب بلغة **محايدة وحذرة** (may, could, tend to) وابعد عن always / all / never.
جملة **However** واحدة + خاتمة بـ **Therefore / Overall** = فقرة قوية.
